Downtown & Gateway Arch.name: Downtown & Gateway Arch
Downtown & Gateway Arch.description: Civic core and riverfront around the Gateway Arch with office conversion, stadium-adjacent hospitality, and the densest CSB 311 volume in the city.

Central West End.name: Central West End
Central West End.description: Medical-and-university district around BJC / WashU with high-value residential rehab and mixed-use infill along Euclid.

The Hill.name: The Hill
The Hill.description: Italian enclave west of Kingshighway with renovation-led permitting, restaurant density, and stable single-family stock.

Soulard & Benton Park.name: Soulard & Benton Park
Soulard & Benton Park.description: Historic market neighborhood and brewery corridor south of downtown with rehab-heavy permitting and hospitality churn.

Tower Grove & Shaw.name: Tower Grove & Shaw
Tower Grove & Shaw.description: South-city garden-district grid around Tower Grove Park with steady single-family rehab and small-commercial renewal.

Old North St. Louis.name: Old North St. Louis
Old North St. Louis.description: Near-north historic district with sparse but targeted rehab, high 311 volume relative to permit activity, and riverfront-adjacent vacant-stock pressure.
